item.title: [Message Center] MC1558032 Microsoft Teams: Intelligent call recap for call queues in the Queues app on mobile
item.description:
Microsoft Teams mobile's Queues app will add intelligent call recap for recorded and transcribed call queue calls starting early December 2026. Users can view AI-generated notes, key points, and follow-up tasks without replaying calls. No admin action is needed, but recording, transcription, and licenses should be confirmed.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1557760 Microsoft Teams: Registration capacity for town halls and webinars increases to 20,000
item.description:
Starting December 2026, Microsoft Teams town halls and webinars registration capacity increases up to 20,000, scaling with attendee capacity. Teams Enterprise allows 3,000 registrations; Attendee Capacity Packs enable up to 20,000. No new policies needed; organizers should ensure proper licensing and update training accordingly.
